attack.name: Sweeps Pounce
attack.telegraph: The grass stops moving the way wind moves it. Two amber eyes — then the whole striped avalanche.

attacks.name: Sweeps Pounce
attacks.telegraph: The grass stops moving the way wind moves it. Two amber eyes — then the whole striped avalanche.

attacks.name: Rerun
attacks.telegraph: It circles, unhurried. It has seen this episode before — and it knows how it ends.

codexStages.observed: Bengal tiger. The System's sweeps-week cut: bigger, bolder, and scheduled. It hunts from cover at dawn and dusk, and it learns — the same tiger works the same ground for years. It does not want a fight. It wants the ambush.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Sweeps Pounce (ambush opener, heavy — it strikes from cover at range), Rerun (close work, patient). It hunts what isn't watching: FACE IT and it hesitates. The Sundarbans trick is real — eyes on the back of your head, or just never look away. Never run; running is prey. Fire earns respect, not safety.
codexStages.unknown: The birds went silent all at once. The grass stopped moving the way wind moves it.

counter.hint: It hunts what isn't watching. The Sundarbans trick is real — and the System kept it.
counter.reveal: FACE IT — or paint eyes on the back of your head — and it hesitates. It wants the ambush, not the fight. Never turn, never run; running is prey. Hold its gaze and back away slow.

curious: It watches from the grass, utterly still. Deciding whether you're worth the trouble.
fearful: It melts back between the stalks. The stripes go with it — but it remembers you.
warn: A coughing roar rolls out of the thicket. Not a warning. A schedule.

edible.note: Rich striped meat — cook it hard; this is the System's cut, not nature's. The fat burns long in a lamp.

encounter.comment: Ambush predator: strikes from cover with no grid warning on the opener. Facing it (the counter) is modeled as hesitation, not immunity.
encounter.knownCue: If the birds stop, it's already moving. Face it.
encounter.knownTactics: Face it and it hesitates. Never run. Fire earns respect, not safety.

name: Sweeps Week
unknown: stripes flowing where no wind blows
vibe: the deadliest week of television, on four silent paws
weaknesses: being faced — it wants the ambush, not the fight
fire (like all cats, it respects flame)

attack.name: Cliffhanger Drag
attack.telegraph: It goes perfectly still. Only the eyes move. Then the water explodes.

attacks.name: Cliffhanger Drag
attacks.telegraph: It goes perfectly still. Only the eyes move. Then the water explodes — and the world starts spinning.

attacks.name: Death Roll
attacks.telegraph: It has your leg. The roll starts. Do NOT let it reach the water.

codexStages.observed: Mugger crocodile. The System's season-finale cut: armored, patient, and always hungry at the water's edge. It doesn't chase — it waits, then the water explodes, then the roll. On land it's a slow-turning tank. In the water it's the studio and you're the guest.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Cliffhanger Drag (lunge from still water, heavy — it tries to pull you under), Death Roll (close range, spinning). The armor shrugs off everything except the eyes and the soft palate — strike there when it lunges. Never fight it in the water. On land, flank it: it turns like a bus.
codexStages.unknown: The creek went glass-still. Two knobs broke the surface — and they were watching you.

counter.hint: The armor has one soft spot, and it's looking at you.
counter.reveal: When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus.

curious: It watches from the water, only the eyes showing. Patient as stone.
fearful: It slides backward into the deep water without a ripple. Gone — but the creek remembers.
warn: The water bulges. Something big just decided you might be food.

edible.note: White meat, firm like fish. The tail is the prize cut — smoke it.

encounter.comment: Water ambush: strongest at creek/wetland tiles; the Drag tries to pull victims toward water. Land flanking is the intended counter-play.
encounter.knownCue: Glass-still water with watching eyes. Don't wade.
encounter.knownTactics: Strike the eyes or soft palate when it lunges. Never fight it in the water; flank it on land.

name: Cliffhanger
unknown: two knobs on glass-still water, watching
vibe: the season finale you don't survive — armored patience with teeth
weaknesses: eyes and soft palate — the only unarmored targets
on land it turns slowly — flank it
